context: Reproduce under Linux WebKit (container or CI re-run with tracing and video), determine whether the benchmark-index query, the DuckDB-WASM worker variant, or a WebKit-specific timing path returns zero rows, and fix the underlying cause. Treat budget changes as forbidden.
description: CI run 30812774015 (WebKit @smoke, non-blocking) failed e2e/routes/benchmark-index.spec.ts on /results/tpch/ with getByText(/TPC-H Results/) element(s) not found, after 3 attempts across a 26.2s budget. The harness message is explicit that this is NOT the cold-snapshot zero-row race the budget is sized for, because re-navigation did not help. This is the only failure in the current batch with no known cause. It is NOT the skeleton-headline defect: local WebKit passes 16/16 @smoke on macOS (verified 2026-08-03 against develop 3af42e29b), so the failure is specific to Linux CI WebKit and is not reproducible locally.
